# contentful Provider

Manages Contentful content and configuration in existing spaces, plus supported organization and account configuration. The provider does not create or delete spaces.

## Authentication

Set `CONTENTFUL_MANAGEMENT_ACCESS_TOKEN` in the environment before running Terraform to avoid placing a Contentful Management API token directly in configuration. You can instead set the `access_token` provider attribute; a configured non-null value takes precedence over the environment variable. The attribute appears as Optional because the environment can supply the token; the provider still requires a known, non-empty token to configure its client. An explicitly empty token overrides the environment and causes an error.

Most configurations should leave `url` unset and use the public Contentful Management API. Use `CONTENTFUL_URL` or the `url` provider attribute only when a different API base URL is required; a configured non-null `url` takes precedence over the environment variable. An empty resolved URL selects the public API.

Space-scoped resources require an existing space ID; organization- and account-scoped resources use their own documented identifiers.

For a complete first configuration and plan, see [Getting started](guides/getting-started). For timeout defaults and environment-readiness behavior, see [Operation timeouts](guides/operation-timeouts).

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    contentful = {
      source = "cysp/contentful"
    }
  }
}

provider "contentful" {}

variable "contentful_space_id" {
  type = string
}

variable "contentful_environment_id" {
  type    = string
  default = "master"
}

resource "contentful_tag" "example" {
  space_id       = var.contentful_space_id
  environment_id = var.contentful_environment_id
  tag_id         = "terraform-example"

  name       = "Terraform example"
  visibility = "private"
}
```

The example requires the ID of an existing Contentful space and, unless changed, uses its `master` environment. The Tag ID `terraform-example` must be unused; import an existing Tag instead. The first plan proposes creating one private `contentful_tag.example` named `Terraform example`; it does not verify the remote space, environment, or permissions for a new Tag. Review the plan before applying it.

## Schema

### Optional

- `access_token` (String, Sensitive) Contentful Management API access token. Set this attribute or the CONTENTFUL_MANAGEMENT_ACCESS_TOKEN environment variable; a configured non-null value takes precedence, including an empty string. Optional in Terraform configuration because the environment variable can supply it; provider configuration requires a known, non-empty token.
- `url` (String) Contentful Management API base URL. Defaults to the public Contentful Management API. Can also be set with the CONTENTFUL_URL environment variable; a configured non-null value takes precedence. An empty resolved URL selects the public API.
